G1.basis_zh: 冻结 source 与候选 ZIP 对应 TASK 字节一致。
G1.basis_en: Frozen source bytes match the candidate ZIP TASK.

G2.basis_zh: 已重算并匹配 source SHA-256。
G2.basis_en: Source SHA-256 was recomputed and matched.

G3.basis_zh: E001–E007 可在冻结 source 回放。

G4.basis_zh: 八个槽位只按 Source 与空 Context 审定。
G4.basis_en: All eight slots use only Source and empty Context.

G5.basis_zh: 长度范围和条件 lint 保持原文语义，未补造配置。
G5.basis_en: Length range and conditional lint retain source meaning; no configuration is fabricated.

G6.basis_zh: 未声明 ontology 或权限绑定。
G6.basis_en: No ontology or authority binding is asserted.

G7.basis_zh: FormalCoverageGap 与 invented_constraints 均为空。

G8.basis_zh: 固定模型与计算可重放。
G8.basis_en: Fixed model and calculation are replayable.

G9.basis_zh: 中文骨架、占位符和排除范围构成唯一边界。
G9.basis_en: Chinese skeleton, placeholders, and exclusions form one boundary.

G10.basis_zh: Profile 缺失，Policy 未评估，Admission 正确未评估。
G10.basis_en: Profile is missing; Policy and Admission are correctly not evaluated.

final_reason_zh: G1–G10 均通过；中文教程骨架任务边界已确定，未生成 ADMIN_GOLD_FROZEN。
final_reason_en: G1–G10 pass; the Chinese tutorial-skeleton boundary is determined and no ADMIN_GOLD_FROZEN is generated.
